company_observations.source_locator: top 5 net sells list; source says around IDR 170 billion

limitations: Company rows are published top-buy/top-sell samples, not the full IDX universe.
A top-list sample is never eligible as a full-universe foreign-flow confirmation signal.
Company rows report net flow only; buy/sell components are intentionally null.
Market buy/sell components are rounded in the source and are not used to overwrite reported net.
Secondary reports are retained as reported descriptive sample evidence with quantitative_use=false, not as a first-party entitlement claim.
The result does not alter leadership, diffusion, or confirmation classification.
Synthetic rows are excluded from the public web payload and live only in synthetic_test_only.

events.title: BBCA ex-dividend in regular and negotiated markets
events.summary: BBCA scheduled a IDR 25 per-share interim dividend, with cum-date 28 August and ex-date 31 August 2026 in the regular and negotiated markets.

events.title: BBRI begins IDR 500 billion MESOP buyback window
events.summary: BBRI announced a maximum IDR 500 billion share buyback for its MESOP programme, scheduled from 12 June through 11 September 2026.

events.title: TelkomMetra reviews strategic options for MDI Ventures
events.summary: TelkomMetra was reported to be reviewing strategic options, including a possible sale, for MDI Ventures; no final decision had been announced.

events.title: BUMI leads foreign net-sell volume list
events.summary: BUMI recorded a foreign net sell of 217.09 million shares on 7 July 2026; this is a volume observation, not a filing or value-based flow metric.

events.title: BBCA directors and commissioner purchase shares
events.summary: Six directors and one commissioner reported purchases made on 16 and 25 March 2026 for long-term investment.
